title: Recyclable and air-stable colloidal manganese nanoparticles catalyzed hydrosilylation of alkenes with tertiary silane
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1776-1781
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08380F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nobuki Katayama, Kazuki Tabaru, Tatsuki Nagata, Miku Yamaguchi, Takeyuki Suzuki, Takashi Toyao, Yuan Jing, Zen Maeno, Ken-ichi Shimizu, Takeshi Watanabe, Yasushi Obora
The manganese nanoparticles we synthesized demonstrated high catalytic activity, achieving 15 800 TON in the hydrosilylation of alkenes with tertiary silanes, and remained recyclable across multiple cycles.
